Bug Description: Login should fail and an appropriate error message should appear.
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open login page. 2. Enter invalid credentials. 3. Click Login.
Comments: Sample practice scenario; verify before reporting as an actual defect.

Bug Description: Search for a specific product and inspect the results.
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open website. 2. Enter a specific product name. 3. Submit search.
Expected Result: Relevant products matching the query should appear.
Comments: Sample practice scenario; verify before reporting as an actual defect.

Bug Title: Price filter displays products outside selected range
Bug Description: Apply a price range and inspect displayed product prices.
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Search a product category. 2. Select a price range. 3. Review results.
Expected Result: Displayed products should satisfy the selected price range.
Comments: Sample practice scenario; verify before reporting as an actual defect.

Bug Description: Add a product to wishlist, sign out and back in, then check wishlist.
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open a product. 2. Add to wishlist. 3. Log out. 4. Log in again. 5. Open wishlist.
Expected Result: The wishlisted product should remain, subject to intended application behavior.
Comments: Sample practice scenario; verify before reporting as an actual defect.

Bug Title: Add to Bag button does not add selected product
Bug Description: Add an available product to the bag and inspect the bag contents.
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open product page. 2. Select size if required. 3. Click Add to Bag. 4. Open bag.
Expected Result: The selected product should appear in the shopping bag.
Comments: Sample practice scenario; verify before reporting as an actual defect.

Bug Description: Apply a valid coupon to eligible products and inspect the order summary.
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Add eligible product. 2. Apply valid coupon. 3. Check order summary.
Expected Result: Discount and final amount should match coupon terms.
Comments: Sample practice scenario; verify before reporting as an actual defect.

Bug Description: Submit address details with an invalid PIN code or missing required field.
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open address form. 2. Enter invalid PIN or omit required field. 3. Click Save or Continue.
Test Data: Invalid PIN code or missing mandatory field
Expected Result: Input should be validated and an appropriate error displayed.
Comments: Sample practice scenario; verify before reporting as an actual defect.

Bug Title: Payment failure is not handled correctly
Bug Description: Simulate a payment failure in an authorized test environment and inspect the response.
Preconditions: User reaches payment stage in an authorized test environment.
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Proceed to checkout. 2. Simulate payment failure using test tools. 3. Observe result.
Expected Result: A clear failure message should appear and order state should be handled safely.
Comments: Use only an authorized payment testing environment; verify before reporting.

Bug Title: Order details are missing from order history
Bug Description: Open an existing successful order from My Orders and inspect details.
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Log in. 2. Open My Orders. 3. Locate recent order. 4. Open details.
Expected Result: Correct order details and status should be displayed.
Comments: Sample practice scenario; verify before reporting as an actual defect.

Bug Title: Eligible order return request cannot be submitted
Bug Description: Submit a return request for an eligible order.
Preconditions: An eligible order is available for return.
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open My Orders. 2. Select eligible order. 3. Click Return. 4. Complete fields. 5. Submit.
Expected Result: Return request should be submitted and confirmation displayed.
Comments: Sample practice scenario; verify before reporting as an actual defect.
